dataset.shard_order: URL-list order within each folder; multi-folder source streams interleaved round-robin by document, stopping at pool quota

extraction_rules.tokenizer_input: full verbatim text; no character clipping or normalization
extraction_rules.acceptance: nonblank str text and at least 128 encoded tokens; one accepted document yields one row
extraction_rules.source_pool: first max(native_quota,no_code_quota) accepted documents per source
